summary.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。 QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
summary.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

limitations.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。 QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数: LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。
limitations.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results. QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

title.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗
title.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares

summary.ja: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。
summary.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

assumptions.ja: m≥nの小さな実行列が対象です。SVDの数値階数は最大特異値に対する相対しきい値10⁻¹²で定義し、零特異値方向を除くcompact因子を返します。QRは列ピボットなしで、階数判定には用いません。
assumptions.en: Small real matrices with m≥n. Numerical rank uses a 10⁻¹² threshold relative to the largest singular value; compact factors omit null directions. QR has no column pivoting and is not used as a rank-revealing method.

algorithm.ja: Householder反射を左から蓄積してRを上三角化し、Qを構成します。Jacobi SVDは列対の内積を小さくする直交回転を繰り返し、回転した列の長さを特異値とします。AᵀAを作って固有値を求める方法ではありません。最小二乗はQRの後退代入、階数落ちでは打切りSVDで求めます。
algorithm.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. The SVD repeatedly rotates column pairs toward orthogonality and uses their resulting lengths as singular values; it does not diagonalize AᵀA. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

validation.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
validation.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

limits.ja: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。
limits.en: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results.

title.ja: QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数
title.en: QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank

summary.ja: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
summary.en: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

assumptions.ja: Hadamard直交因子U,Vとsⱼ=2⁻qj、q=0/4/8/12を使います。b=u₀とb+2⁻⁴⁰u_minを固定し、摂動増幅を測ります。q=0の重複特異値では個々の特異ベクトルは一意ではありません。
assumptions.en: Use Hadamard orthogonal factors U,V and sⱼ=2⁻qj for q=0/4/8/12. Fixed b=u₀ and b+2⁻⁴⁰u_min measure perturbation amplification. Individual singular vectors are nonunique for the repeated singular values at q=0.

algorithm.ja: Householder QR、片側Jacobi SVD、三角後退代入を実装します。SVDの数値階数閾値を10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴へ変え、同じ切捨て規約のLAPACK解と比較します。正規方程式の計算例は追加していません。
algorithm.en: Implement Householder QR, one-sided Jacobi SVD and triangular back substitution. Vary rank cutoffs 10⁻⁸/10⁻¹²/10⁻¹⁴ and compare with LAPACK solutions using the same truncation convention. No executed normal-equations comparison is added.

validation.ja: 再構成・直交性・特異値・右辺摂動による解差・最小二乗停留残差・厳密階数2の対照を保存します。高精度参照は実二進入力を整数比へ変換し、mpmath 1.3.0のSVDとQRを独立実行済みです。SHAと全4入力・両精度の完全性を実行時に検査し、不一致を解析解へ置換しません。
validation.en: Save reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, solution perturbations, least-squares stationarity and an exact rank-two control. The mpmath1.3.0 SVD and QR reference was actually executed using integer-ratio conversions of binary inputs. Runtime SHA and completeness guards check all four inputs at both precisions and never substitute analytic truth after a mismatch.

limits.ja: LAPACKと教材の射影コアには共通の数値基盤が含まれます。mpmath SVDは別実装の二重対角化とQR反復、mpmath最小二乗は同じHouseholder群の別高精度実装です。どの高条件数行列にも微小特異値の相対高精度を保証するものではありません。
limits.en: Some LAPACK and projected-core numerical infrastructure is shared. mpmath SVD uses separate bidiagonalization and QR iteration; mpmath least squares is a separate high-precision implementation of the same Householder family. Tiny-singular-value relative accuracy is not guaranteed for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.

review.ja: SVDはHouseholder二重対角化とQR反復、最小二乗は別実装の高精度Householder QRです。後者は教材のQRと同じ数理的手法群であり、別の手法群とは呼びません。実際の二進浮動小数点入力を整数比で読み込み、生成専用環境で実行しました。
review.en: SVD uses Householder bidiagonalization and a QR variant; least squares uses a separate high-precision Householder QR implementation. The latter shares the educational QR mathematical family and is not called a different algorithm family. Actual binary floating-point inputs were loaded by integer ratios and executed in a generation-only environment.
